payload.body_you: You keep telling yourself {{holder1}} probably means more than they are saying, even though the plan never gets confirmed and the follow-through keeps changing. You may be holding onto the version you hoped for while {{holder1}} is giving you much less to work with.
payload.body_they: {{holder1}} starts planning around something they thought you meant, even though the two of you never clearly agreed to it. By the time you realize the difference, {{holder1}} may already feel disappointed by a promise you did not know you made.
